name: Sakurai Mifuyu
source:
A third-year student and a member of the basketball team. Though her father is an actor and her mother used to be an idol, Mifuyu doesn’t worry to much about not having any talent like her parents. She has a polite and elegant personality and is also famous for her beauty. When the bus fell, her abdomen got lacerated.

[From Shiori-chan's review]
